citations.claim: first energy_bound violation: energy far exceeds E0+10%+5J limit 2684.42 at step31
energy just before violation is ~1065J, showing abrupt 13kJ jump in one step
heavy body0 gains spurious horizontal speed 38.4 m/s (vx 38.4) while on floor y=0.806=r
one step earlier body0 speed only 7.49 m/s, vx -1.93, proving discontinuous energy injection between 30->31

counterfactual.change: Changed bodies[1].e from 0.64488853004566249 to 0 - makes incoming collision fully inelastic, removing restitution impulse that combined with ground resting contact to inject energy. Same dt/steps/gravity, now passes with no violation.

explanation: Shrunk case has heavy body0 (m=19.3, e=0) falling to rest on floor (y=r at step31) while light fast body1 (m=1, e=0.645, vy≈-26) collides obliquely from above. Between step30 and 31 the solver resolves simultaneous ground-contact and body-body contact in same substeps (22-25 substeps, dt~0.0246). Instead of at most partially restituting the incoming vertical kinetic energy, it injects large spurious horizontal velocity into the heavy body (vx -1.93 → +38.4), raising total energy from ~1065 J to 14653 J (>5× initial 2435 J, controller_work=0). This is classic positional-correction / sequential-impulse double-counting for a resting contact + incident collider with mass ratio ~19:1 and non-zero restitution. Setting e=0 on the incident body removes the restitution impulse branch and eliminates the gain, confirming restitution/contact handling as cause.
vision_note: Steps 28-30 show a small blue circle falling from above onto a larger blue circle as both descend toward the floor, the large circle settling at the bottom edge. At step 31 the small circle makes oblique contact on the upper-left side of the large circle exactly as the large circle reaches y=r on the floor, with the pair touching/overlapping and no tunneling or large positional jump visible between 30 and 31.
